title: Splunk Architecture: Forwarders, Indexers, Search Heads, and Management Components
objectives: Splunk Architecture: Forwarders, Indexers, Search Heads, and Management Components
Verify the result through independent inspection and explain the observed state.

tasks.instruction: Inspect the Lab topology in Environments or Fleet Overview. In Terminal run ssh splunk@ds01, hostname and splunk version. Exit to the bastion; inspect idx01 and sh01 similarly.
Identify which component owns forwarder app distribution. Enter its component role using the simulator role name (for example search_head).

hints: Inspect the affected component or inventory file first.
Use the documented command output to answer the evidence questions.

feedback.success: Completion requires verified observations, evidence answers and the required operational state.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect the failed checks; edits on disk may need activation.
